name: SME Portal Hub
notices: Version 0.1.0 is an initial development release. Features, data structures, and upgrade procedures may change before version 1.0.0.

changes: Added product version, release notice, public repository, and revision history information to System settings.
Added verified full-database backup, update, and disaster-recovery tools for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Added role name management and replaced editable role codes with immutable permission identifiers.
Improved Work calendars with automatic public-holiday imports and responsive employee assignment controls.
Added language-aware employee name formatting and localized gender and length-of-service labels.
Added employee email actions and made IT asset notes easier to identify.
Improved responsive layouts across Settings, System settings, master data, and asset management screens.
Added date-safe active-data backup and restore verification tools.
